globalRules: Canonical wording, trigger, visible information, imperfect information and options come from the Documento Maestro; do not replace them with generic veteran choices.
A signable or negotiable club proposal must be backed by a real CareerOffer or another explicitly approved authoritative negotiation object; rumor, marketHeat and flags are insufficient.
Narrative choices do not directly mutate club, ownerClub, registrationClub or contract terms.
When CareerTerms cannot represent a canonical clause/bonus/role promise, keep the scene blocked or model the promise as non-contractual memory only if canon and shared authority explicitly permit it.
Any option that terminally retires the player is delegated to Agent 9; Agent 8 may preserve the visible option and nonterminal intent/handoff only.
Do not invent outcome effects merely to make a card executable. Effects remain implementation_pending until the listed authority can express the canonical choice safely.
All events additionally require Wave 0 lineage, canonical seed catalog/provenance and save/pending/history compatibility.
